name: RAMPAGE: SAVE LILLY
description: Lilly has been captured. The Warden controls the tower, and you're the only one who can bring her home. Play as Jax: run, jump and climb through the Foundry, the Machine and the rising Surge, face the towering cybernetic Warden, and save Lilly. Chase the high score on the weekly leaderboard. ENTER. SURVIVE. CONQUER. Created by All Things Gamed. A/D move, W/S climb, Space jump, P pause.
